title: Joint Petition of New England Hydro-Transmission Electric Company, Inc. and New England Power Company for a determination that proposed electric transmission lines in the Towns of Tyngsborough, Dunstable, Groton, Ayer, Shirley, Lancaster, Sterling, West Boylston, Boylston, Shrewsbury, Grafton, Millbury, Sutton, Upton, Milford, Medway, and the City of Leominster and the alteration of existing transmission lines in the Towns of Ayer, Shirley, Lancaster, Sterling, West Boylston, Boylston, Shrewsbury and Millbury are necessary and would serve the public convenience and be consistent with the public interest.
petitioner: New England Hydro-Transmission Electric Company, Inc.
